adds.title: United Nations joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity - 2011
adds.summary: On 22 March 2011 the Marshall Islands joined the Human Rights Council joint statement on ending acts of violence and related human rights violations based on sexual orientation and gender identity, which expressed concern at killings, rape, torture and criminal sanctions on those grounds and called on states to end violence, criminal sanctions and related violations against individuals because of sexual orientation or gender identity.

adds.title: European Court of Human Rights - January 2019 judgment against North Macedonia on legal gender recognition
adds.summary: In January 2019 the European Court of Human Rights ruled in favour of a Macedonian transgender man seeking to change his gender on his birth certificate.

adds.title: U.S. Department of State - Country Reports on Human Rights Practices for 2019: North Macedonia
adds.summary: In 2019 in North Macedonia, violence against LGBTI individuals was a significant human rights issue.

adds.title: Constitutional Court of North Macedonia - 14 May 2020 decision
adds.summary: On 14 May 2020 the Constitutional Court repealed the Law on Prevention and Protection against Discrimination, thereby removing legal protection against discrimination including on sexual orientation and gender identity.
